tools.name: nozbeteams_list_teams
tools.description: List the Nozbe spaces (teams) the token can see, with plan info. Good first call. API: GET /teams.

tools.name: nozbeteams_get_team
tools.description: Get one Nozbe space (team) by id. API: GET /teams/{id}.

tools.name: nozbeteams_list_team_members
tools.description: List members of the visible spaces with role (owner/admin/member) and status. Use nozbeteams_list_users to resolve user names. API: GET /team_members.

tools.name: nozbeteams_list_users
tools.description: List the users visible to the token (id, name, time zone). Use it to turn an author_id or responsible_id into a name. API: GET /users.

tools.name: nozbeteams_list_projects
tools.description: List projects, optionally for one space. Set is_single_actions to true to find the Single Actions project of a space. API: GET /projects.

tools.name: nozbeteams_get_project
tools.description: Get one project by id, with description and state. API: GET /projects/{id}.

tools.name: nozbeteams_list_project_sections
tools.description: List sections (columns or groups) of projects, optionally for one project. API: GET /project_sections.

tools.name: nozbeteams_list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks. Filter by project, assignee, completion and due date. Dates are Unix milliseconds. Each task has name, project_id, responsible_id, due_at, ended_at. API: GET /tasks.

tools.name: nozbeteams_get_task
tools.description: Get one task by id with all its fields. API: GET /tasks/{id}.

tools.name: nozbeteams_list_comments
tools.description: List comments, optionally for one task. API: GET /comments.

tools.name: nozbeteams_list_task_events
tools.description: List the activity log of tasks (changes made), optionally for one task. API: GET /task_events.

tools.name: nozbeteams_list_tags
tools.description: List tags, optionally by name or for one task. API: GET /tags.

tools.name: nozbeteams_list_tag_assignments
tools.description: List which tags are on which tasks, by task or by tag. API: GET /tag_assignments.

tools.name: nozbeteams_create_task
tools.description: WRITE: create a task. Without project_id the task goes to the Single Actions project of the token owner. Use responsible_id 'author' to assign it to the token owner. Not retried on failure. API: POST /tasks.

tools.name: nozbeteams_update_task
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of a task. Set ended_at to a Unix ms time to complete the task. Only the fields you pass change. API: PUT /tasks/{id}.

tools.name: nozbeteams_create_comment
tools.description: WRITE: add a comment to a task. Visible to people who can see the task. Not retried on failure. API: POST /comments.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: nozbeteams_list_comments · Private data: nozbeteams_list_teams, nozbeteams_list_users, nozbeteams_create_task · Public sink: nozbeteams_create_task, nozbeteams_create_comment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: nozbeteams_list_comments · Private data: nozbeteams_list_teams, nozbeteams_list_users, nozbeteams_create_task · Public sink: nozbeteams_create_task, nozbeteams_create_comment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
